switcher.loadError: The machines could not be loaded.

settings.description: Other Rooks machines this computer can drive. Switching replaces the whole interface with the chosen machine's, in this same window: each machine keeps its own agents, projects and settings.
settings.local: The machine this interface is served from.
settings.addHint: On the other machine, open {settingsPath} and authorize a new device: it shows a one-time code, valid 5 minutes. The machine must be reachable over HTTPS (tailscale serve, a reverse proxy…).
settings.loadError: The list of machines could not be loaded.
settings.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from this computer? Its access is revoked on that machine, and what this browser kept for it is erased.
settings.removedNotRevoked: Machine removed. It could not be reached: revoke this computer in its Devices settings.

errors.invalidCode: The machine refused this code: wrong, expired or already used. Ask it for a new one.
errors.invalidUrl: This address cannot be used: give the machine's address alone, with no login, query or fragment.
errors.httpsRequired: The machine must be reached over HTTPS. Plain HTTP is only accepted on this computer itself.
errors.blockedAddress: This address never points to a Rooks machine.
errors.notTimon: No Rooks machine answers at this address.
errors.requiresTls: The machine does not see this connection as HTTPS: check the HTTPS settings of its reverse proxy.
errors.unreachable: The machine cannot be reached right now.
errors.unauthorized: The machine no longer accepts this computer: its access was revoked or expired. Pair it again.
errors.redirect: The machine answered with a redirect: give its final address.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.tooMany: A fleet holds at most 50 machines.
errors.vault: The secrets vault is unavailable: machine access cannot be kept.
errors.incompatible: This machine runs a Rooks version too old for this interface. Update it first.
errors.notFound: This machine is no longer in your fleet.
errors.notHere: Machines are managed from a browser signed in on this computer.
errors.sessionRequired: Sign in on this computer first.

banner.apiUnknown: {name} does not say which interface it expects: some screens may not work.
banner.apiNewer: {name} runs a newer Rooks than this interface: update this app to use it fully.

title.incompatible: {name} is too old for this interface
title.unknown: This machine is not in your fleet

body.unreachable: The machine does not answer: it may be off, or its network unavailable. Your work on it is untouched.
body.unauthorized: This computer's access was revoked or expired on that machine. Pair it again from {settingsPath}.
body.incompatible: It speaks interface level {level}, and this interface needs at least {min}. Update Rooks on that machine, then switch to it again.
body.unknown: The machine this window was driving was removed from your fleet, or belongs to another account.
body.session_required: Your session on this computer ended. Go back to it to sign in again.
body.unavailable: This computer cannot open its access to the machine right now (secrets vault, daemon). Try again in a moment.

lock.remote: This licence is the one of {name}, the machine this window drives. This computer is not affected.

localOnly.remoteSessions: These are the remote API tokens of this computer, not of the machine this interface is switched to.
